My dear [Ellie](/person/663)-
Thank you for your letter. We have heard nothing more, and hardly look for anything, and indeed there had been only one letter from [him](/person/1610) since he joined [Baden-Powell](/person/2202), but that was enough to leave us no doubt that it is himself. [^1] I am so glad he had that year at home after the Matabele War.
He was very much loved here. There was to have been a ‘Social Evening,’ but the people begged to put it off for they could not enjoy it.-
Your affectionate
C. M. YONGE.


[^1]: CMY\'s nephew George Yonge, killed on 22 October 1899 at Crocodile River, Rhodesia, during the Boer War.
